query: SELECT e.id, e.lessonId, l.title, e.question, e.correctAnswer FROM exercises e JOIN lessons l ON l.id = e.lessonId WHERE e.question LIKE '%I have a ___.%' OR e.question LIKE '%She ___ to school%' OR e.question LIKE '%first word you learn%' OR e.question LIKE '%mean in Portuguese%' ORDER BY e.lessonId;
